# rpc-project

> Simple RPC service for controlling every aspect of a remote machine — a C server and a Python client.

rpc-project: a C server and Python rpcclient for calling native functions and controlling a remote machine (filesystem, processes, network, HID, ObjC, and more).

## Getting started

- [Home](https://doronz88.github.io/rpc-project/latest/index.md)
- [Installation](https://doronz88.github.io/rpc-project/latest/installation/index.md)
